# `operation-path-changed`

Path changed for the same operationId

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `operation-path-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Paths and operations ([RULES.md section 2](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An operation with the same `operationId` and method moved to a different path, e.g. a path parameter was added or removed, or a prefix changed.

## Why this default

Old clients call a URL that no longer exists.

## Example

From test case [`operation-path-changed`](../../test/cases/operation-path-changed/): Same operationId and method at a new path: the path changed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
    version: 1.0.0
  paths:
-   '/pets/{id}':
+   '/animals/{id}':
      get:
        operationId: getPet
```

Findings:

- `operation-path-changed` · error · GET /animals/{id}

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  operation-path-changed: error
```

## How to fix

Keep serving the old path (e.g. as a deprecated alias) until clients have moved.
